description: This file defines a React component 'ExploreMindmapDetailsPanel' that displays detailed information about a selected role node within an explore view of a web application. It fetches additional role details via API calls and renders role attributes such as industry, description, skills, tags, and compatibility score.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Normalizes an unknown value to a trimmed string, defaulting to an empty string if null or undefined.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to an array of non-empty trimmed strings.

methods.name: looksLikeUuid
methods.description: Checks if a string matches the pattern of a UUID.

methods.name: roleIdFromRole
methods.description: Extracts the role ID from a role object, considering various possible property names.

methods.name: roleTitleFromRole
methods.description: Extracts the role title from a role object, considering various possible property names.
